title: Inbound Approval Limit by Selling Plan, FBN Shortage Cases
content:
Selling Plans decides the inbound approval limit on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound-shortage case: the large-store inbound limit of 40 units for a seller whose selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store, and the mid-store inbound limit of 20 units for Basic Store or Premium Store. For any other selling plan the inbound approval limit is not altered by this provision.

The plan is the one shown on the seller's Selling Plans record on the handling date.

- Anchor Store, Enterprise Store: 40 units.
- Basic Store, Premium Store: 20 units.
- Any other selling plan: not altered by this provision.

Illustration (hypothetical): two sellers with identical shortage claims, one on Enterprise Store and one on Basic Store, are held to limits of 40 units and 20 units respectively.
